_readme: Architecture map: from what you click in SAP GUI to the tables and systems behind it. 'verify' = check in your own system with F1 → Technical information or SE11 (if you have display rights).

nodes.label: Patient screens
nodes.short: Create, change, display patient master data.
nodes.detail: Name, date of birth, address, AHV number, patient-level insurance. Changes here affect every future case of this person.

nodes.label: Case processing
nodes.short: Central screen for the case: admission, movements, insurance, cost coverage.
nodes.detail: Tabs for case data, movements and insurance relationships. Your Kostensicherung work happens here: checking the insurer and documenting the result.

nodes.label: Remark field
nodes.short: Free-text note you write after the cost check.
nodes.detail: Find out where it is stored: click into the field → F1 → Technical information. Is it on the patient, the case or the insurance relationship? Long texts are often saved as SAP texts linked to the object.

nodes.label: Billing
nodes.detail: Creates invoices from the case, its services and insurance relationships.

nodes.label: Patient management
nodes.detail: Checks mandatory fields, duplicates, admission rules. Much of the behaviour is set in Customizing (case types, movement types, insurance types).

nodes.label: Insurance & cost coverage
nodes.short: Who pays: KVG, UVG, IV, VVG, self-payer; cost coverage (Kostenübernahme).
nodes.detail: Insurance relationships exist per patient and are assigned to the case. Cost coverage/approval data is attached to the case's insurance relationship. Check the exact tables in your system.

nodes.label: Patient accounting
nodes.detail: Valuates services with tariff tables, groups inpatient cases (SwissDRG grouper interface) and creates invoices.

nodes.label: Communication
nodes.detail: Patient movements go out as ADT messages to KISIM, lab, radiology. Errors land in a monitor.

nodes.label: NPAT
nodes.detail: Duplicate rows for one person = split history and wrong invoices.

nodes.label: NFAL
nodes.short: One row per case (stay or outpatient series).
nodes.detail: Case type (inpatient/outpatient), organisational unit, referring doctor.

nodes.label: NBEW
nodes.detail: Drives bed occupancy, length of stay and ADT messages.

nodes.label: NLEI
nodes.detail: Source for invoices and revenue completeness checks.

nodes.label: NGPA
nodes.detail: GLN and ZSR identifiers live here. Outdated partners cause rejections.

nodes.label: Long texts
nodes.short: SAP standard storage for long texts.
nodes.detail: Many free-text notes are stored as SAP texts linked to an object key, not as a column in the main table. That's why reports can't easily read them.

nodes.label: KISIM (Cistec)
nodes.detail: Receives patient and case data from IS-H (HL7 ADT). Will be replaced by Epic, which combines clinical and admin data.

nodes.label: VeKa-Center (SASIS)
nodes.short: Online validation of insurance card data.
nodes.detail: Used at registration and by bots to confirm insurer and card number.

nodes.label: Insurers & cantons
nodes.detail: Invoices as XML (Forum Datenaustausch standard), usually via an intermediary such as MediData. Cost approvals increasingly electronic (e.g. SHIP).

nodes.label: SAP FI / CO
nodes.detail: Invoices post to receivables; payments and dunning run in finance; revenues flow to controlling.

nodes.label: Reporting
nodes.detail: Extracts from IS-H tables feed reports (rejection rate, open cost approvals). Free text is hard to report on.

steps.text: You open the case in NV2000.
You check the insurance relationship (KVG / VVG / canton).
Card data is validated against SASIS.
If needed, cost approval is requested from the insurer or canton.
You document the answer in the remark.
The remark is (probably) stored as a long text – verify with F1.
Billing later relies on the insurance relationship, not on your remark.
